explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/207 (high-girth Steiner triple systems, Kwan–Sah–Sawhney–Simkin). For each g ≥ 2 and all large n ≡ 1, 3 (mod 6), there is a 3-uniform hypergraph on Fin n in which every pair lies in exactly one edge (IsBlockDesign 2 3) and any j edges with 2 ≤ j ≤ g span at least j + 3 vertices.
